title: Japanese Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese-inspired beef stew made with a variety of vegetables and served over a bed of steaming hot rice.

ingredients.name: Brass
ingredients.notes: such as bok choy or napa cabbage

instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, soy sauce, and Gochujang to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Add the chopped bok choy to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until wilted.
Serve the beef and stew over a bed of steaming hot rice.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
